description: This file defines a speech provider plugin for MiniMax TTS, including configuration normalization, directive parsing, voice listing, and synthesis functions.

methods.name: trimToUndefined
methods.description: Trims a string value or returns undefined if not a valid string.

methods.name: asNumber
methods.description: Converts a value to a finite number or returns undefined.

methods.name: asObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-null object and not an array.

methods.name: readMinimaxProviderConfig
methods.description: Reads and merges provider configuration with defaults.

methods.name: readMinimaxOverrides
methods.description: Processes overrides for voice and speech settings.

methods.name: parseDirectiveToken
methods.description: Parses directive tokens to produce speech overrides and warnings.
